purpose: Verify material transitions from Draft/Unpublished to Scheduled when future release is configured.
preconditions: Course exists; faculty is assigned.
action_or_input: Faculty configures material with future release date.
expected_result: Material enters Scheduled state.

purpose: Verify scheduled material transitions to Published/Available when release time is reached.
preconditions: Material is in Scheduled state with release time in past.
expected_result: Material transitions to Published state and becomes available.

purpose: Verify material in Scheduled state remains withheld before release time arrives.
preconditions: Material is Scheduled with future release time.
expected_result: Material is not visible in student materials list.

purpose: Verify new assignment transitions to Draft state upon creation with valid parameters.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to course.
action_or_input: Faculty creates assignment with valid title, due date, submission type, and points.
expected_result: Assignment state is Draft.

purpose: Verify assignment in Draft state transitions to Published and Available when immediate release is published.
preconditions: Assignment is in Draft state.
action_or_input: Faculty publishes assignment with immediate release.
expected_result: Assignment state is Published and visible to students.

purpose: Verify available assignment records submission when student submits on-time matching configured type.
preconditions: Assignment is Available; student is registered; current time before due date.
expected_result: Student submission is recorded with SUBMITTED status.

purpose: Verify publishing draft assignment without required configuration fails and assignment remains Draft.
preconditions: Draft assignment lacks required due date.
expected_result: Publication fails with validation rule error; state remains Draft.

purpose: Verify assignment in Draft transitions to Scheduled when published with future release date.
preconditions: Draft assignment has future release date and valid due date.
action_or_input: Faculty publishes assignment with future release timing.
expected_result: Assignment enters Scheduled state.

purpose: Verify scheduled assignment transitions to Available when system processes release time.
preconditions: Assignment is in Scheduled state with release time in past.
action_or_input: System scheduled assignment release task runs.
expected_result: Assignment transitions to Published/Available.

purpose: Verify student can submit on-time to newly released scheduled assignment.
preconditions: Assignment has been released; current time is before due date.
expected_result: Submission is recorded with SUBMITTED status.

purpose: Verify student cannot submit to assignment while it remains in Scheduled state.
preconditions: Assignment is in Scheduled state with future release date.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit work before release date.
expected_result: Submission attempt is rejected with ConflictError.

purpose: Verify recorded student submission transitions to Grade Draft when faculty grades it.
preconditions: Student submission exists; grader is faculty.
expected_result: Grade is recorded in Draft state with faculty attribution.

purpose: Verify grade in Draft state transitions to Released when faculty releases grades.
preconditions: Grade is in Draft state; actor is faculty.
expected_result: Grade transitions to Released state.

purpose: Verify grade in Draft state is invisible to student until release transition occurs.
preconditions: Grade is in Draft state.
expected_result: Grade is not exposed (returns None).

purpose: Verify recorded student submission transitions to Grade Draft with TA attribution when TA grades it.
preconditions: Student submission exists; grader is assigned TA.
expected_result: Grade is recorded in Draft state with TA user ID attribution.

purpose: Verify TA draft grade transitions to Released when faculty performs release.
preconditions: Grade was drafted by TA; actor is faculty.
expected_result: Grade transitions to Released state.

purpose: Verify TA cannot perform grade release transition.
preconditions: Grade is in Draft state; actor is TA.
expected_result: TA grade release is prohibited.

purpose: Verify complete composite workflow from draft creation to immediate publish to on-time submission.
preconditions: Faculty and student are enrolled in course.
action_or_input: Faculty creates draft -> publishes immediately -> student submits on-time.
expected_result: All transitions succeed and student submission is recorded.

purpose: Verify complete composite workflow from draft creation to scheduled release to system auto-release to on-time submission.
preconditions: Faculty and student are enrolled; future release scheduled.
action_or_input: Faculty creates draft -> schedules release -> system auto-releases -> student submits on-time.
expected_result: All transitions succeed sequentially ending in recorded submission.

purpose: Verify complete composite workflow from submission to faculty grading to grade release to student viewing.
preconditions: Submission exists; faculty grades and releases.
action_or_input: Faculty grades submission -> releases grade -> student views released grade.
expected_result: Grade is released and student views final score.

purpose: Verify complete composite workflow from submission to TA grading to faculty grade release to student viewing.
preconditions: Submission exists; TA grades -> faculty releases.
action_or_input: TA grades submission -> faculty releases grade -> student views released grade.
expected_result: Grade transitions from draft to released and student views score.
